summary: Smileup — a social media app. Fixing two critical bugs: profile page stuck in skeleton/loading state never showing real user data, and post creation failing with 'Failed to create post' error for all content types.
known_issues: Profile page stuck in skeleton/loading state — never loads real user data (avatar, name, posts)
Post creation fails with 'Failed to create post. Please try again' error for all content types (text, images, videos)

existing_features.title: Fix the ProfilePage so it correctly fetches and displays the authenticated user's real data (avatar, display name, bio, follower/following counts, and posts grid) instead of remaining stuck in the skeleton/loading placeholder state indefinitely.

Fix the backend query/mutation wiring in ProfilePage so the useGetMyProfile (or equivalent) hook properly resolves — ensure the actor is initialized before the query runs, error states are handled gracefully, and the profile data is correctly mapped from the backend response variant to the UI state.

Fix the CreatePostPage so that submitting a post (text, image, or video) succeeds instead of showing 'Failed to create post. Please try again.' Diagnose and repair the useCreatePost mutation: ensure media blobs are correctly encoded and passed to the backend, the actor call parameters match the backend's expected argument types, and success/error states are handled properly.
